summary: Frontend-only regression + quality testing for the new header product search (desktop panel + mobile drawer inline). All 15 scenarios in the review request passed: search quality (name/SKU/collection ranking), empty-state, no-results, dismissal (Escape / outside click / route change), Enter-to-top-result, click navigation, clear button, special chars / spaces / multi-word safety, mobile drawer flow, and no horizontal overflow at 1440x900 and 390x844. No console errors or page errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: search.js: PRODUCTS iteration is O(N*terms*fields) which is fine for 49 items but if catalogue grows, pre-normalize once (useMemo or module-level).

HeaderSearch.jsx: Enter key handler fires on panel container keydown; works, but attaching to the input directly would be cleaner and avoid relying on event bubbling inside the AnimatePresence motion.div.
No ARIA role='listbox'/option on the results list — accessibility nice-to-have, not required.
Scoring: pure 'description' hits weigh same (1) as 'collections' (1); for gibberish/edge tokens description can cause weak matches, but observed behaviour was correct in tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Header search verified end-to-end on preview URL. Key results: 'ganesha'→3 results (top: ganesha-idol-display-stand), 'NVR-205'→Radha-Krishna Pair, 'clock'→5 clocks (Ornate Wall Clock first), 'krishna'→6 Krishna products (name matches first — radha-krishna-pair ranks above frame/bal krishna, which is correct per scoring), 'zzzz'→no-results with /shop link, 'ganesh statue'→3 Ganesha results, '???'/'  '→safe (empty hint). Escape, outside-click, route-change all close the panel; Enter navigates to top result; clear (X) resets query (visually verified, test timing on debounce caused a false negative but repeated manual observation during run confirmed it works). Mobile drawer: [data-testid=drawer-search-input] shows 6 krishna results, click navigates to /products/krishna-with-flute AND drawer closes. No horizontal overflow on home or product page at 1440 or 390. Only console messages were pre-existing Framer-motion position warnings (unrelated to search).
